title: vigil.error/v0
description: Every non-200 response body from the listener. Missing and wrong tokens produce byte-identical bodies, and no reason detail is ever echoed.

code.description: Stable machine code, e.g. unauthorized, not_found, method_not_allowed, payload_too_large, query_warnings, series_cap, backend_unreachable.

message.description: Optional human text. Never contains a token, a URL or a reason the caller could use to distinguish missing from wrong credentials.
